Below: There's a fair few miles been walked by the legs belonging to these two gents. For Eric Hall (left) it was fifty years since his first turn-out in a Belgrave '7'. He placed 140th that day in 1948 (31st Belgravian home with another two behind him) in a race won by Harry Churcher. George Beecham (right) will be celebrating the half a century since his début in this race in 2000.

Happy with a seventh successive year in the medals at the National Road Relay.
